'''Bajaj Finserv Limited''' is an Indian [[financial services|non-banking financial services]] company<ref>[https://www.bloomberg.com/quote/BJFIN:IN "Bajaj Finserv Ltd"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160319092803/http://www.bloomberg.com/quote/BJFIN:IN |date=19 March 2016 }} ''Bloomberg''. Retrieved 2014-11-03.</ref><ref>[http://www.indiainfoline.com/markets/company/background/company-profile/bajaj-finserv-ltd/28075 "Bajaj Finserv Ltd"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150924050947/http://www.indiainfoline.com/markets/company/background/company-profile/bajaj-finserv-ltd/28075 |date=24 September 2015 }} ''India Infoline''. Retrieved 2014-11-03.</ref> headquartered in [[Pune]]. It is focused on [[lending]], [[asset management]], [[wealth management]] and [[insurance]].<ref>[http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/bajaj-finserv-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-21426.cms "Bajaj Finserv Ltd."] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150226151521/http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/bajaj-finserv-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-21426.cms |date=26 February 2015 }} ''The Economic Times''. Retrieved 2014-11-03.</ref><ref>[http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/Business/India-Business/Bajaj-Finserv-to-float-a-housing-finance-company/articleshow/42194853.cms "Bajaj Finserv to float a housing finance company"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150222221842/http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/Business/India-Business/Bajaj-Finserv-to-float-a-housing-finance-company/articleshow/42194853.cms |date=22 February 2015 }} ''The Times of India''. Retrieved 2014-11-03.</ref>

==History==
The financial  services and wind energy businesses were transferred to Bajaj Finserv Limited (BFL) as part of the concluded demerger from [[Bajaj Auto|Bajaj Auto Limited]], approved by the High Court of Judicature at [[Bombay]] by its order dated 18 December 2007.<ref>[http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2007-08-18/news/27675728_1_demerger-scheme-bajaj-holdings-bajaj-auto "Bajaj Auto demerger approved"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141217035850/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2007-08-18/news/27675728_1_demerger-scheme-bajaj-holdings-bajaj-auto |date=17 December 2014 }} ''The Economic Times''. Retrieved 2014-11-03.</ref><ref>{{Cite book |last=Saraogi |first=Rahul |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=HMMiAwAAQBAJ&dq=Bajaj+Finserv&pg=PA122 |title=Investing in India, + Website: A Value Investor's Guide to the Biggest Untapped Opportunity in the World |date=2014-04-21 |publisher=John Wiley & Sons |isbn=978-1-118-75609-6 |language=en |access-date=27 May 2023 |archive-date=12 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240512043310/https://books.google.com/books?id=HMMiAwAAQBAJ&dq=Bajaj+Finserv&pg=PA122 |url-status=live }}</ref> It is a financial conglomerate with stakes in the financing sector (Bajaj Finance),<ref>{{Cite web |last=Chatterjee |first=Sinjinee |date=2018 |title=To evaluate the perception of the parent brand Bajaj vis-à-vis Bajaj Finserv |url=http://tapmi.informaticsglobal.com/617/ |access-date=2022-08-31 |website=tapmi.informaticsglobal.com |language=en |archive-date=31 August 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220831164253/http://tapmi.informaticsglobal.com/617/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>[http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/bajaj-finserv-s-q1-consolidated-net-profit-rises-14-114071600994_1.html "Bajaj Finserv's Q1 consolidated net profit rises 14%"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141104070358/http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/bajaj-finserv-s-q1-consolidated-net-profit-rises-14-114071600994_1.html |date=4 November 2014 }} ''Business Standard''. Retrieved 2014-11-03.</ref> the life insurance business (Bajaj Life Insurance), the general insurance business (Bajaj General Insurance),<ref>{{Cite web |last1=Gandhi |first1=Kajal |last2=Narnolia |first2=Vishal |last3=Sawant |first3=Sameer |date=September 22, 2021 |title=Bajaj Finserv (BAFINS): Improving prospects of key subsidiaries to add value |url=https://www.icicidirect.com/mailimages/IDirect_BajajFinserv_CoUpdate_Sep21.pdf |access-date=31 May 2022 |website=[[ICICI Bank|ICICIDirect]] |archive-date=26 May 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220526121349/https://www.icicidirect.com/mailimages/IDirect_BajajFinserv_CoUpdate_Sep21.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Karwa |first=Atul |date=28 October 2020 |title=Initiating Coverage Bajaj Finserv Ltd. |url=https://www.hdfcsec.com/hsl.research.pdf/Bajaj%20Finserv%20-%20Initiating%20Coverage%20-%20281020.pdf |access-date=31 May 2022 |website=[[HDFC securities]] |archive-date=17 June 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220617172058/https://www.hdfcsec.com/hsl.research.pdf/Bajaj%20Finserv%20-%20Initiating%20Coverage%20-%20281020.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref> and the mutual fund business (Bajaj Finserv Mutual Funds).<ref>{{Cite news |date=2023-06-06 |title=Bajaj Finserv Mutual Fund launched |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/mf/mf-news/bajaj-finserv-mutual-fund-launched/articleshow/100786766.cms |access-date=2023-06-28 |issn=0013-0389 |archive-date=13 June 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230613091142/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/mf/mf-news/bajaj-finserv-mutual-fund-launched/articleshow/100786766.cms |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2023-06-06 |title=Bajaj Finserv forays into mutual funds |language=en-IN |work=The Hindu |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/bajaj-finserv-forays-into-mutual-funds/article66938561.ece |access-date=2023-06-28 |issn=0971-751X |archive-date=13 June 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230613055831/https://www.thehindu.com/business/bajaj-finserv-forays-into-mutual-funds/article66938561.ece |url-status=live }}</ref>

Bajaj Holdings and Investments Limited (BHIL) came into existence when the original company separated its auto and finance assets. This new entity, BHIL is the parent company which holds 39.29% stake in Bajaj Finserv.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Bajaj Holdings & Investment Ltd. |work=Business Standard India |url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/bajaj-holdings-50/information/company-history |access-date=2022-10-09}}</ref>

Apart from financial services, it is also active in [[wind energy]] generation with an installed capacity of 65.2 MW.<ref name="auto" /><ref>{{cite news |title=Post division, brothers Rajiv and Sanjiv Bajaj taking Bajaj Group to new highs |newspaper=The Economic Times |url=http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2014-07-01/news/51002912_1_sanjiv-bajaj-bajaj-group-rahul-bajaj |access-date=2014-11-03 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140707070328/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2014-07-01/news/51002912_1_sanjiv-bajaj-bajaj-group-rahul-bajaj |archive-date=2014-07-07}}</ref><ref>[http://www.thewindpower.net/windfarm_en_17161_bajaj-finserv-ltd.php "Bajaj Finserv Ltd windfarm (India)"] ''The WindPower''. Retrieved 2014-11-03.</ref>

As of 1 July 2025, the [[Bajaj Group]] holds a 55% stake in the company.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Conchie |first=Charlie |date=1 July 2025 |title=India's Bajaj Finserv hiks customer target to 250 million |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/india/indias-bajaj-finserv-hikes-customer-target-250-million-2025-07-01/ |access-date=3 December 2025 |work=[[Reuters]]}}</ref>

== Subsidiaries ==

===Bajaj Finance===
[[Bajaj Finance]] was initially incepted as Bajaj Auto Finance in 1987 and later diversified into business and property financing.<ref>{{cite web |title=Profitability Analysis of Lease Financing Company (A Study with Reference to Bajaj Finance Limited) |url=https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3572491 |website=papers.ssrn.com |ssrn=3572491 |access-date=27 December 2023 |archive-date=14 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230714172705/https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3572491 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |last=Meenakshi |first=Arun Kumar & N. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=mDlDDAAAQBAJ&dq=Bajaj+Finserv&pg=PA778 |title=Marketing Management, 2nd Edition |date=2011 |publisher=Vikas Publishing House |isbn=978-81-259-4259-7 |language=en |access-date=27 May 2023 |archive-date=12 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240512055121/https://books.google.com/books?id=mDlDDAAAQBAJ&dq=Bajaj+Finserv&pg=PA778 |url-status=live }}</ref>

====Bajaj Housing Finance====
Bajaj Housing Finance provides housing finance services, including home loans and loans against property. It is a subsidiary of Bajaj Finance.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Babel |first=Rajeev |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=nIckEAAAQBAJ&dq=Bajaj+Housing+Finance&pg=SA8-PA22 |title=Handbook of Non-Banking Financial Companies |date=2021-03-15 |publisher=Bloomsbury Publishing |isbn=978-93-90176-20-5 |language=en |access-date=8 July 2023 |archive-date=12 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240512060125/https://books.google.com/books?id=nIckEAAAQBAJ&dq=Bajaj%20Housing%20Finance&pg=SA8-PA22 |url-status=live }}</ref>

Bajaj General Insurance (formerly Bajaj Allianz General Insurance<ref name=":1" />) is a private [[general insurance]] company<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.livemint.com/Money/5dFM2ktg0LWCfiMjPBouFN/Bajaj-Finserv-justifies-the-rise-in-share-price.html |title=Bajaj Finserv justifies the rise in share price |date=20 May 2015 |access-date=3 as a joint venture between Bajaj Finserv and [[Allianz SE]] in 2001.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Ashokbhai Kalola |first=Aneri |date=2024-03-30 |title=A COMPARATIVE STUDY OF FINANCIAL PERORMANCE [sic] |url-status= |access-date=2025-01-12 |website=[[Atmiya University]] |page=38 |via=[[DSpace]]}}</ref> In 2025, Bajaj Finserv acquired Allianz SE's stake in Bajaj Allianz General Insurance for {{INRConvert|13780|c|year=2025}}.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":2" /> By January 2026, Allianz had fully exited the insurance business in India, increasing the group’s overall holding in both insurance arms to 97%.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Navin |first=Nishit |editor-last=Biswas |editor-first=Shreya |title=India's Bajaj Group completes 23% stake acquisition in its insurance units from Allianz |website=scanx.trade |language=en}}</ref>.

|website=Financialexpress |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-10-24 |title=Bajaj Finserv Q2 Profit up 8 Per cent at Rs 2,087 Cror ===Bajaj Finserv Direct===
Bajaj Finserv Direct (Bajaj Markets) operates as an internet-based marketplace of financial products and services. It serves as a registered Corporate Agent under [[Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority]], a registered Investment Adviser under [[Securities and Exchange Board of India]], a registered third-party app provider for [[Unified Payments Interface]] payments, and a digital lending platform for its partner institutions.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Loans on Bajaj Markets: Address diverse needs with 9 products |url=https://www.aninews.in/news/business/business/loans-on-bajaj-markets-address-diverse-needs-with-9-products20230512150432/ |access-date=28 June 2023 |website=[[Asian News International]] |archive-date=12 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230512130353/https://www.aninews.in/news/business/business/loans-on-bajaj-markets-address-diverse-needs-with-9-products20230512150432/ |url-status=live }}</ref>
